label: Algebraic Logic Functional
proposed_definition: ALF is a programming language combining evaluable functions with logic programming rules.
ambiguity_note: Exact expanded name in the author’s manual, not a generic paradigm.

label: Bassa
ambiguity_note: Bassa [bsq] is the exact catalog-name candidate. Bassa-Kontagora [bsr] is distinct, and Glottolog 5.4 lists Bassa as a German alternative name for Basa (Cameroon) [bas]. Confirm the intended code.

label: Batak
ambiguity_note: Exact catalog name Batak [bya] is separate from Batakic and Batak Toba [bbc]; do not use the exact label match alone to infer intended scope.

label: Carib
ambiguity_note: Galibi Carib [car] is a candidate language sense, not the entire Cariban family; confirm scope.

label: Fali
ambiguity_note: Fali [fli] is the exact catalog-name candidate. North Fali [fll], South Fali [fal], and Baissa Fali [fah] have separate codes; metadata does not establish which identity was intended.

label: Gaelic
ambiguity_note: May refer to Scottish Gaelic, Irish, or a wider label; do not map to one code without context.

label: Jiba
proposed_definition: Jiba is a human language cataloged as ISO 639-3 juo.
ambiguity_note: Exact catalog match; Jibu [jib] is a separate language, not an alias.

label: Kachin
ambiguity_note: May refer to a Jinghpaw language sense or a broader identity; a Jingpho family record alone does not settle scope.

label: Korwa
proposed_definition: Korwa is a human language cataloged as ISO 639-3 kfp.
ambiguity_note: Exact label and language-level match in the local linkage; no alias inferred.

label: Ladino
ambiguity_note: Catalog Ladino [lad] is the Judeo-Spanish candidate, not proof that a bare label refers to that sense.

label: Lango
ambiguity_note: Confirm Lango (Uganda) [laj] or Lango (South Sudan) [lgo]. The broader legacy code [lno] was deprecated on 2022-02-25; the IANA registry lists four successor candidates without a single preferred replacement.

label: Lawa
proposed_definition: Lawa is a grouping that includes Eastern Lawa and Western Lawa.
ambiguity_note: Umbrella proposal only; Eastern [lwl] and Western [lcp] are separately cataloged languages.

label: Ndebele
ambiguity_note: Confirm North Ndebele [nde] or South Ndebele [nbl]. They have separate code entries; the unqualified label does not select one.

label: Ovambo
proposed_definition: As a language label, Ovambo can refer collectively to Wambo varieties such as Ndonga and Kuanyama.
ambiguity_note: Umbrella proposal only; distinguish the collective language use from a specific variety or community label.

label: Silesian
ambiguity_note: The exact Silesian [szl] record differs from the Lower Silesian [sli] German-language record; confirm the intended sense.

label: Tatar
proposed_definition: Tatar is a Turkic language cataloged as ISO 639-3 tat.
ambiguity_note: Exact catalog match supports this standalone sense, not conflation with Crimean Tatar [crh].

label: Tharu
proposed_definition: Tharu is an umbrella label used for multiple languages, including Rana Tharu and Dangaura Tharu.
ambiguity_note: Umbrella proposal only; do not assign a single code, or infer that all Tharu entries form one family.
